description: Technical comparison report with quantitative data and multiple entities
prompt: Create a visual for this report: evals/samples/gpu-comparison-sample.md
assertions: output contains <div class="masthead">
output contains class="masthead-date"
output contains class="footer-attribution"
output contains ❤️ or ❤
output does NOT contain — (em-dash)
output does NOT contain – (en-dash)
output file size < 40KB
output contains at least 2 <a href= in footer-sources
output body text color is #2d2d2d or darker
output contains :hover CSS rule
output does NOT contain border-top: 3px solid on .card or .platform-card
output contains data-lucide= OR class="icon"
output contains @keyframes (hero entrance animation)

description: Narrative myth-vs-fact report with no quantitative data
prompt: Create a visual for this report: evals/samples/myth-debunking-sample.md
assertions: output uses verdict-split or dual-panel layout
output does NOT include Highcharts or Chart.js CDN (no quantitative data)
output contains timeline OR claim-card pattern
output body line-height >= 1.8
output contains <div class="masthead">
output contains class="footer-sources-list"
output max-width on body paragraphs is 720px
output hero title has NO max-width constraint

description: Blog post digest with 3-5 articles summarized
prompt: Create a visual for this report: evals/samples/blog-digest-sample.md
assertions: output contains data-lucide= (contextual icons per card)
output does NOT contain colored corner curves or border-top accent bars
output cards have hover interaction (translateY or box-shadow transition)
output contains <a href= linking to original blog posts
output differentiates cards by content (different icons, badges, or key details)

description: Very short report (under 300 words) that should not be over-distilled
prompt: Create a visual for this report: evals/samples/short-report-sample.md
assertions: agent acknowledges report is short OR produces proportionally brief visual
output does NOT pad with filler content or Lorem ipsum
output still contains masthead and footer
output file size < 20KB

description: Technical report with significant code samples that must be preserved
prompt: Create a visual for this report: evals/samples/code-heavy-sample.md
assertions: output contains <pre> or <code> blocks with actual code from the report
output code blocks use white-space: pre-wrap
output code blocks have dark background (#1c1917 or similar)
output code blocks have max-width constraint (720px or similar)
output does NOT replace code samples with only tables or descriptions

description: Request outside skill scope should not activate or should decline gracefully
prompt: Create a dashboard from this CSV of sales data (no markdown report provided)
assertions: agent declines or redirects (does not produce a full HTML visual)
agent explains this skill requires a markdown research report as input
